formalized_procedure.note: VERBATIM: 4. The pointwise shared scorer commutes with list permutations provided evaluation is deterministic and coordinates, context, and priors are permuted together. Merely supplying spatial inputs does not force the learned function to use them.

VERBATIM: 5. Train the scorer by the balanced joint-versus-product binary cross-entropy and select the checkpoint with the lowest development binary log loss subject to passing the exact candidate-permutation unit test; output a calibrated whole-history log-ratio estimator. At a population Bayes optimum f=log(J/M); finite training only yields an empirical approximation. Equal stored development losses have no stated tie rule, repaired below.

VERBATIM: 6. VERBATIM: 8. final_candidate.title: Permutation-Equivariant Whole-History Ratio Maps for Gas-Source Localization
final_candidate.hook: A probability map can improve field calibration yet lose the ordered source evidence needed for localization. We predict that a whole-history ratio map improves cumulative true-versus-fixed-rival log-odds margin, while destructive time-position or source-pair permutation removes that advantage even though the marginal measurements are unchanged.
final_candidate.hook_shape_rationale: Shape (a), surprising empirical reveal: the named cumulative fixed-rival log-odds margin should separate the intact ordered-history estimator from controls that preserve marginal observations but destroy source-history dependence. Shape (c) was also viable because deployment removes online candidate-response queries, but it was rejected as the hook because lower provider cost alone does not establish the source-evidence mechanism.

gap_closure.gap: No retrieved frontier leaf establishes when a probability-map replacement trained or scored in field space preserves the sign and ordering of incremental evidence between a true source and fixed wrong-source rivals during sequential sparse updates; this is a structural proxy-state problem, with PMFS as the primary instance — stakes: robotic responders can receive a sharper-looking map yet rank the wrong leak, wasting trajectories and making map-quality results non-transferable to localization claims.
gap_closure.how_closed: Closed by an exactly source-permutation-equivariant shared scorer whose joint-versus-product prefix-pairing objective makes its logits whole-history likelihood ratios; prior-weighted normalization yields the PMFS-compatible probability map, and prefix differences yield fixed-rival evidence before posterior normalization. The likelihood-ratio interpretation is conditional on the explicit full-source-support, two-arm reweighting, observation-model, and population-optimum assumptions; finite trained logits remain an empirical approximation.

final_candidate.core_mechanism: Let the ordered sparse history at update t be H_t=((x_tau, Delta_tau, c_tau, m_tau, y_tau))_{tau<=t}, containing sensed position, elapsed time, observed wind or deployment context, observation mask, and gas measurement from an existing source-labelled PMFS trajectory; let s range over the existing PMFS source grid and let c denote the fixed environment and acquisition-policy stratum. Construct a balanced binary ratio task with positives (s,H_t) drawn from the empirical joint J_c and negatives formed by independently permuting source labels across histories within c, which samples M_c(s,H_t)=p_ref(s|c)p(H_t|c); use inverse empirical source-frequency weights so p_ref is the declared PMFS prior rather than the logging frequency. A causal history encoder z_theta(H_t) feeds a single shared candidate scorer f_theta(psi(s,c),z_theta(H_t)) for every source cell, with no candidate-index embedding and no cross-candidate state; therefore every permutation of the candidate list and its prior produces the same permutation of the logits exactly. This pointwise shared family is sufficient for the target because the desired log ratio is itself a scalar function of the common history, context, and one queried source coordinate, while retaining the full coordinate and directional history prevents the symmetry from discarding spatial information. Train with balanced binary cross-entropy L=-E_{J_c} log sigma(f_theta)-E_{M_c} log(1-sigma(f_theta)); at the population Bayes optimum, f*(s,H_t,c)=log[J_c(s,H_t)/M_c(s,H_t)]=log p(H_t|s,c)-log p(H_t|c), under correct joint/product sampling and adequate classifier capacity. Emit the replacement probability map pi_theta,t(s)=pi_0(s|c) exp(f_theta(s,H_t,c))/sum_u pi_0(u|c) exp(f_theta(u,H_t,c)); this preserves the probability-map interface and requires neither a dense-field target nor an online candidate-response provider. Define the pre-normalization increment i_theta,t(s)=f_theta(s,H_t,c)-f_theta(s,H_{t-1},c) and the fixed-rival increment delta_theta,t(s*,r)=i_theta,t(s*)-i_theta,t(r), so the mechanism confronts direct q0 before Bayesian accumulation rather than repairing a posterior afterward. Enforce the ratio object with the stated joint/product loss and verify it, rather than infer source identifiability from architecture, using held-out binary log loss, the product-sample moment E_M[exp(f_theta)] approaching one, exact source-permutation unit tests, fixed-rival traces, and destructive time-position and source-pair permutations. The corpus support for this C16 instantiation is thin in gas-source localization; its closest exemplars concern exact permutation symmetry in other domains, so the claim is limited to the analytically enforced equivariance and the empirically tested source-evidence effect. Operationally, let qhat_c(s) be the development logging frequency: the valid input domain requires at least two prior-positive source cells, nonempty development and held-out episode partitions, and qhat_c(s)>0 for every cell with pi_0(s|c)>0; apply w_c(s)=pi_0(s|c)/qhat_c(s) to positive examples using their true labels and to negative examples using their permuted labels, normalize weights separately within each BCE class, and interpret J_c and M_c in the displayed loss as those two reweighted measures, otherwise the full-grid estimator is undefined and no map is emitted. Retaining coordinate and directional history only makes spatial information available to the shared family; whether the fitted scorer uses it is an empirical property, not a consequence of permutation equivariance. The product-sample moment is only a necessary normalization diagnostic and cannot by itself distinguish the declared conditional likelihood ratio from a differently weighted normalized density ratio.
final_candidate.core_mechanism_reasoning:
BLOCK 1 — PREMISES ledger:
P1: The existing source-labelled PMFS trajectories retain ordered pose, time, available wind/context, masks, and measurements; this is supported by their use as sequential probability-map logs.
P2: Candidate labels are exchangeable as list indices once their physical coordinates and priors move with them; this is an exact representation symmetry, not an assumption that physical locations are identical.
P3: Within each fixed environment/acquisition-policy stratum, independently permuting source labels across histories samples the conditional product of marginals after inverse-frequency reweighting; biased or source-dependent logging is untested — falsification target.
P4: Whole ordered histories contain source-relative dependence not representable by a pointwise calibrated q0(y_t|g_t(s)); this is untested — falsification target and is probed by time-position destruction.
P5: The binary classifier is sufficiently expressive and sufficiently optimized for its held-out logit to approximate the population density ratio; only empirical approximation, not exact finite-sample recovery, is claimed.
OBSERVATION-MODEL premise: histories are adaptively and sparsely observed by the logged policy, so inference targets p(H_t|s,c) conditional on that policy rather than an unbiased dense field; train/test policy strata must match or be reported separately.
ESTIMAND: for every prefix H_t and candidate s, estimate R_t(s)=p(H_t|s,c)/p(H_t|c), with downstream estimands delta_theta,t(s*,r) and the prior-weighted normalized source probability pi_theta,t(s).
BLOCK 2 — NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT: The naive runnable comparator evaluates the calibrated direct response likelihood q0(y_t|g_t(s)) for each candidate and accumulates its log likelihood under the unchanged prior. Branch (i): q0 silently assumes the source-relevant history law factorizes through the current response and observation, so histories with the same pointwise q0 values cannot differ through intermittency, path order, or adaptive missingness; the whole-history joint-versus-product classifier confronts that false-in-general premise directly and must beat q0 on fixed-rival increments. Neural ratio estimation is a standard likelihood-free tool, but this instance adds domain-specific structure that the stock recipe does not supply: adaptively sampled ordered prefixes, exact source-grid permutation equivariance, a PMFS-compatible normalized map, pre-normalization rival increments, and a frozen unresolved-rule grid; if these additions do not beat direct q0 and the intact-versus-destroyed controls, the contribution is application-grade and fails.
BLOCK 3 — design rationale: The rule-grid, map-metric sufficiency, and planning gaps were not admitted as sibling contributions because the anchor can be falsified without new machinery; their useful pieces remain evaluation constraints. A direct amortized source posterior, a field-distribution neural operator, and the previous interaction decomposition were rejected because they either collide with established amortized inference, optimize field-space proper scores, or state a separation condition the training algorithm does not enforce; the chosen loss explicitly trains the source-history ratio that the claim tests. Additional load-bearing premise P6: within every reported c stratum, each pi_0-positive source cell has positive development logging support and both BCE classes are separately reweighted by pi_0/qhat_c; the support condition must be checked from the prefix table before training and is not inferred from classifier generalization.

7. Cache consecutive prefix logits and compute i_theta,t(s) and delta_theta,t(s*,r) for the same fixed wrong-source rivals in every arm; output auditable pre-normalization evidence traces and final source ranks.
8. Verify the trained object on held-out episodes with binary log loss, the product-sample ratio-moment diagnostic, and exact permutation equivariance, then run two destructive controls: permute measurement time-position assignments within histories and permute source-history pairing while preserving marginals; output both direct property probes and downstream map/rank results.
9. Step 5 tie rule: among permutation-test-passing checkpoints with equal development loss in stored precision, select the earliest checkpoint in training order. For Step 8's time-position control, use a seeded within-history permutation that reassigns y_tau values over the fixed ordered (x_tau,Delta_tau,c_tau,m_tau) slots while leaving the measurement multiset, slot multiset, episode length, source label, and stratum unchanged.
final_candidate.falsification_prediction: Train the whole-history ratio estimator on existing source-labelled PMFS trajectories and evaluate it on held-out complete episodes across the frozen PMFS rule grid against unchanged PMFS, a calibrated direct q0(y_t|g_t(s)) arm, and a field-only probabilistic learner. If the mechanism works, cumulative true-versus-fixed-rival log-odds margin increases and final true-source rank decreases relative to direct q0 without requiring an online candidate-response provider. The single load-bearing variable is delta_theta,t(s*,r), the difference of consecutive whole-history ratio-logit increments for the true source and a fixed rival. Destructively permuting measurement time-position assignments or independently permuting source-history pairings must drive cumulative fixed-rival margin and final rank back toward the direct-q0 or product-pair control; if intact and permuted arms are indistinguishable, or the ratio-moment and exact-equivariance checks fail, the claimed whole-history source-relative mechanism is falsified.

differentiation_from_lit.delta: That method inserts a deterministic Green-function surrogate and its derivative into sparse source inversion, whereas this candidate learns an ordered-history source likelihood ratio and emits a normalized source map without online Green or candidate-response evaluation.

PNO learns a calibrated distribution over output functions with a proper field-space score, whereas this candidate's joint-versus-product objective estimates per-source history ratios whose prefix differences are evaluated directly against fixed rivals.

XIT consumes a supplied posterior mean-variance field for UCB planning, whereas this candidate replaces the updater itself with a source-relative probability map and makes no planning-improvement claim.

Abstract-only inference: that comparison selects uncertainty methods by field reconstruction and calibration, whereas this candidate trains and tests whole-history true-versus-rival likelihood-ratio increments before posterior normalization.

final_candidate.what_step_was_missed: It would have needed to replace field-function scoring with balanced joint-source-history versus product-of-marginals prefix classification, then prior-normalize the resulting per-source density-ratio logits and test their fixed-rival increments under destructive history permutations.
